round: R1 - locked cross-context aggregate response prediction benchmark

response_construction.qc: ngenes>=500, ncounts>=1000, percent_mito<=20; targeting cells nperts==1 and no '+'-named perturbation (multi-perturbation excluded from primary, retained as sensitivity); controls perturbation=='control' AND nperts==0
response_construction.unit: target x context; cells are replicates
response_construction.inclusion: >=30 QC-pass cells AND >=2 distinct construct-level guide_id values per (target x context); targets failing in any task-relevant context are ABSTAINED (predefined abstention), not imputed
response_construction.pseudobulk: pooled-count rate vs matched NTC control rate within the same context; control matching strata = obs batch column where present (Replogle), condition itself for Frangieh; log2((r_unit*1e6+1)/(r_ctl*1e6+1))
response_construction.shared_genes: exact gene_name match across the two contexts of a task; retain genes with control CPM>=1 in BOTH contexts; frozen list + hash before outcome inspection
response_construction.variance_filter_abstention: targets whose response vector has per-target variance below the 5th percentile of the NTC-pool variance distribution in the destination context are ABSTAINED as low-variance (predefined)

primary_held_out_target.descriptor_frozen: the target's source-context response vector ONLY (e.g. K562 response when predicting RPE1); no versioned sequence/annotation features are used; destination-context response of that target is never visible to fitting - leakage assertions mandatory
primary_held_out_target.if_no_descriptor: honest primary baseline is the destination context mean; if the descriptor channel fails, the arm closes rather than leaking source responses
primary_held_out_target.evaluation: 5-fold held-out-target CV, frozen seed 20260922; no target in two folds

secondary_held_out_context.frangieh_rotations: train {Control, Co-culture} -> IFN-gamma; train {Control, IFN-gamma} -> Co-culture; train {IFN-gamma, Co-culture} -> Control

models_frozen: context mean (destination-context mean response over training targets)
ridge per destination gene on source response vector (alpha nested)
kernel ridge RBF (alpha, gamma nested within training targets only)
low-rank factorization: rank-k SVD of training response matrices, k in {5,10,20} nested
k-NN transfer in source-response space, k in {3,5,10} nested

gates.G1_freeze: cohorts, shared-gene lists, folds frozen with manifest + hashes before scoring
gates.G2_identifiability: descriptor channel verified; leakage assertions pass (no destination response in any fit input)
gates.G3_accuracy: per-target Pearson AND R^2 beat context-mean, cross-context-mean AND ridge baselines with target-bootstrap 95% CI excluding the best baseline, in BOTH Replogle directions AND >=1 Frangieh held-condition rotation
gates.G4_top50: top-50 destination response-gene recovery beats expression-matched and target-permuted null 95th percentiles
gates.G5_calibration: 90% predictive intervals (target-bootstrap residual quantiles) achieve empirical coverage within [0.80, 0.97]
gates.G6_reproducibility: independent rerun reproduces identical sha256 of the prediction file
gates.G7_jurkat_bonus: Jurkat usable only if overlap/support passes this pre-outcome gate: >=20 shared targets with >=30 cells AND >=2 constructs; else excluded and recorded

reporting: effect-size distribution (median + IQR + full deciles), never mean alone
abstention classes reported: low-variance, missing descriptor, unsupported target
SP-007 negative transport evidence preserved and cited
Frangieh reported as an independent condition axis, NOT independent lab replication of the cell-line task
product_output: measurement-priority estimates with uncertainty + information-gain proxy (predicted |response| mass times interval width reduction); never causal or treatment claims; compute/runtime, reviewer protocol, licenses, monitoring, rollback sections required
arm_closure: if held-target prediction lacks a valid pre-intervention descriptor or fails baseline superiority, close that arm; continue held-context under its separate evaluation
